Home.description: Chat in real time with friends or strangers. Create your own room or join an existing one to start conversing.
Home.featureIncognitoDesc: No accounts, no phone numbers, no personal data. Your identity stays completely anonymous. Messages are deleted every 24 hours.
Home.featureRealtimeDesc: Messages appear instantly for everyone in the room. No delays, no refreshes — just pure conversation.
Home.featureRoomsDesc: Create open rooms for anyone to join, or lock them behind a 6-character code for private conversations.
Home.featureFilesDesc: Share images, videos, and documents up to 5 MB directly in the chat with drag-and-drop simplicity.
Home.step1Desc: Start a new room in seconds, or join an existing one with a link.
Home.step2Desc: Send messages, share files, and talk in real time with no limits.
Home.step3Desc: No sign-up required. Your data is never stored. Messages vanish daily.
Home.ctaDesc: Join thousands of users chatting anonymously every day.

Info.title: Information
Info.description: Learn how to use UmbraChat and all its features.
Info.createRoomDesc: Create a public or private chat room. Give it a name and description, and choose who can join.
Info.joinRoomDesc: Join any public room by searching its name, or go directly to a room if you have the link.
Info.realTimeChatDesc: Send messages and see them instantly. Messages are broadcast to everyone in the room in real time.
Info.privateRoomsDesc: Protect your room with a 6-character password. Guests must enter the code to access the chat. The password is hashed and never stored in plain text.
Info.searchRoomsDesc: Find public rooms by name. Results update as you type, with pagination for easy browsing.
Info.customizationDesc: Customize the interface: choose between sans-serif or monospace font, adjust text size (small, medium, large), and switch between purple and blue accent colors.
Info.languageDesc: Switch between English and Spanish from the settings page. The interface language updates instantly.
Info.chatHistoryDesc: Rooms you create or join are saved in your browser. Access them anytime from the My Chats page.
